text:
Nora: Heads-up  Verdura case story + webinar assets. Interview set for Fri 9:30am PT with Verdura's CTO. Deliverables: 1 short pull-quote for the blog, one 20s spoken clip for the webinar, 8-10s demo B-roll, and transcript. Can legal do same-day review?
Priya: I'll run the interview and capture a clean 20s take. Will also grab B-roll of the admin dashboard.
ClipBot: Recording slot reserved: https://drive.redwood/verdura/session_4123.mp4
Dev (sales): For lead routing we want a 1-field form (email) + interest checkbox. Need a 1-line quote for the slide by 11am so SDRs can prep outreach.
Lin (legal): Quick reminder: any numeric claims (%s, ms) require written customer consent. If they say numbers live, please get an email confirmation or sign-off. Otherwise we'll use redacted language like "measurable reductions in cost."
Omar (product): Small wording preference: if we mention our feature, use `continuous batching` and `KV cache` exactly. Avoid ambiguous terms like "batching" alone.
Nora: Raw quote candidate from Verdura (verbatim): "Redwood lowered our inference spend by roughly 33% and cut tail latency significantly." Posting for legal.
Lin (legal): Replace `roughly 33%` with `substantially` unless Verdura's counsel signs off on the number. Also need a signed media release for the clip if we publish video/webinar. I'll reach out now.
Priya: I'll capture both versions (numeric + cleaned) and mark timecodes. If legal prefers the cleaned line, I'll have the CTO read: "We saw substantial reductions in inference cost and faster latency."
Dev (sales): If we redact numbers, this slide text works: "Verdura saw substantial cost savings and faster latency." SDR-ready.
Omar (product): If Verdura confirms numbers later, ask for the source metric (per-token or per-request) so we use the correct phrasing.
Lin (legal): Noted. I'm messaging Verdura's counsel for explicit permission; will update thread when I hear back.
Nora: Timeline recap: Fri 9:30am interview -> Priya uploads masters + clips by 3pm -> Lin to approve public quote or request redaction by 6pm -> Dev builds Typeform + webhook by EOD.
ClipBot: Reminder scheduled: legal follow-up in 3 hours.
Priya: Uploads will include: master audio, MP4 clip (20s), B-roll (8-10s), and transcript. Will post links here once live.
Nora: Thanks all. Minimal ask: one approved sentence for the webinar slide by 11am. Ping here if anything blocks. :rocket:
